name: railway-ops
description: Railway multi-service operations: managing separate services within one project, per-service environment variables, service identification, restart/redeploy patterns, and cross-service wiring (when one service needs to call another). Use when working with Railway projects that have multiple services (web, telegram-listener, api, bot, etc.) — especially when adding a new env var to one service and needing to check/set it on others.
